mission_prompt: Ingest uploaded government cloud migration RFP, extract mandatory technical compliance criteria, model multi-tier labor pricing, and generate a winning executive proposal with compliance traceability matrix.

units.description: Load the uploaded government cloud migration RFP (PDF/Word), convert it to structured text, and extract all sections that contain mandatory technical compliance criteria. Store the extracted criteria in a tabular format with columns: Criterion ID, Description, Source Paragraph, and any referenced standards or regulations.
units.input_contract: Requires verified outputs from upstream dependency nodes: [None - Initial Branch Node]
units.output_contract: A CSV/JSON table of all mandatory technical compliance criteria identified in the RFP.

units.description: Using the extracted compliance criteria, design a multi‑tier labor pricing model that assigns cost rates to each required skill set (e.g., Cloud Architect, Security Engineer, Compliance Analyst). Include tier definitions (e.g., Tier 1: Senior, Tier 2: Mid, Tier 3: Junior), hourly rates, and projected effort per criterion. Output the model as a structured table.
units.input_contract: Requires verified outputs from upstream dependency nodes: [t1]
units.output_contract: A pricing matrix with tiers, skill categories, hourly rates, and estimated hours per compliance requirement.

units.task_name: Generate Executive Proposal with Traceability Matrix
units.description: Compose a winning executive proposal that: (1) summarizes the solution approach, (2) presents the multi‑tier labor pricing model, and (3) includes a compliance traceability matrix linking each RFP criterion to the proposed solution component and its associated cost. Format the output as a structured document (e.g., Markdown or Word outline) with clear headings, bullet points, and tables.
units.input_contract: Requires verified outputs from upstream dependency nodes: [t1, t2]
units.output_contract: A complete executive proposal document containing solution narrative, pricing summary, and compliance traceability matrix.

dag.goal: Create a comprehensive executive proposal for a government cloud migration RFP that includes mandatory technical compliance criteria extraction, multi‑tier labor pricing modeling, and a compliance traceability matrix.
dag.reasoning: The request requires three distinct phases: ingesting the uploaded RFP document, extracting and structuring the mandatory compliance requirements, building a tiered labor cost model, and finally synthesizing an executive proposal that links each requirement to its corresponding solution and cost. Each phase is independent enough to be executed in parallel where possible but must preserve data flow from one stage to the next.
